instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, responsive, highly converting local bakery web app in React JS + Tailwind + Framer Motion + Lucide Icons + Shadcn UI.
Implement the backend endpoints in FastAPI for handling custom cake order enquiries (`POST /api/enquiry`) and saving to MongoDB or in-memory fallback.
Ensure ALL interactive elements have clear `data-testid` attributes as specified in `components_structure`.
Highlight key selling points: Google 4.9 Star Rating, Royal Special Cake, Pineapple Cake, Fresh Fruit Cake, LGBTQ+ Friendly, Wheelchair Accessible, Free Parking, Opening hours 9am-9pm.
Include a sticky mobile action bar with Quick Call and WhatsApp Order buttons for high mobile conversion.
Use Lucide icons (Lucide-react) for icons like Phone, MapPin, Clock, Star, ShoppingBag, Heart, ShieldCheck, Wheelchair, Car, Truck.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid default centered designs or generic templates. Create rich visual hierarchy with asymmetric bento layouts, fine gold borders, and ambient dark chocolate hues.
DO NOT use full screen gradients without tint or texture.
Ensure contrast ratio is WCAG AA compliant on all text elements.
Always provide data-testid on interactive buttons, inputs, links, cards, and section containers.
